item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 30/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring brighter and relatively dry weather to southern China today. It will be gradually replaced by a maritime airstream in the following couple of days. It will become cloudier over the region. An anticyclone aloft is expected to affect the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. The weather will improve and it will be hot during the day with one or two showers over the region. A trough of low pressure will affect Guangdong in the latter part of this week.
